Strategy: Weaken the pure bonus band reward to fifteen, testing whether a gentler bonus for leftovers between twenty-eight and forty-two still beats Best Fit. It may help by nudging rather than forcing the band, but may fail if the bonus becomes too small to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
